text:
jamie_support: customer ondedged-app reporting 403 when creating completions with a key that our console shows as ACTIVE. they say it worked yesterday. sample curl and response pasted below. any ideas?

jamie_support: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions 
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX\" 
 -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-1.3","input":"hi"}'```

jamie_support: response: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` - body: `{\"error\":{\"code\":\"forbidden\",\"message\":\"access blocked\",\"reason\":\"plan_entitlement\"}}`

jamie_support: customer says they are on a paid seat and just converted from trial last night. billing shows their invoice succeeded. they used SSO to create the team.

ryan_eng: thanks. quick things: can you paste the full request headers we log (take out key) and the `x-account-plan` value if present? also which region?

jamie_support: region: us-west-2. headers we captured: 
```
:authority: api.redwood.ai
:method: POST
:scheme: https
accept: application/json
content-type: application/json
authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX
x-account-id: acct_9876
x-account-plan: free
user-agent: curl/7.86.0
```

jamie_support: oh — `x-account-plan` shows `free` even though billing portal says `pro-monthly`.

maya_product: fyi we ran a tenant plan migration yesterday (rollout: plan-mapper v2). could be related.

ryan_eng: that header is generated by the entitlement proxy. if the plan mapper job failed to map the SSO claim -> plan SKU, the proxy can default to `free` which triggers plan_entitlement 403s. sounds like a sync gap.

ryan_eng: quick repro steps for us: 1) create team via SSO with claim `tier: pro`. 2) run plan-mapper job to sync billing -> entitlement-store. 3) call API with token tied to SSO session. If entitlement-store shows `free` for that account, request gets 403 with reason `plan_entitlement`.

jamie_support: can you confirm whether the entitlement-store was updated for acct_9876?

ops_bot: deployment notice: plan-mapper v2 rollout completed on prod us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T21:04Z, job id pm-20260315-42

ryan_eng: looking now — scanning logs for pm-20260315-42. give me a sec.

ryan_eng: found a gap: pm job retried on some tenants and our write to entitlement-store returned 409 for accounts with pending billing-webhook race. those accounts were left in previous state (`free`). acct_9876 is in that list.

maya_product: ack. this explains customer reports. what's the remediation plan?

ryan_eng: short term: we can re-run a targeted sync for affected account ids and force write (idempotent write + overwrite flag). will push a script to run against pm-20260315-42's failure list. longer term: add an upsert path and reorder billing webhook -> plan-mapper handshake to avoid races.

jamie_support: pls run targeted sync and reply here when done so I can unblock customer.

ryan_eng: running now. script: ```python sync_entitlement.py --account acct_9876 --force-overwrite```

ops_bot: job pm-fix-20260315-999 queued, running on us-west-2.

ryan_eng: done — entitlement-store shows `pro-monthly` for acct_9876, cache invalidation triggered, KV TTL cleared.

ryan_eng: can you have customer retry? should be immediate but might need to wait for CDN cache (few seconds).

jamie_support: pinged customer. they retried and confirm completions now succeed. :tada:

maya_product: great. please add this account id to the incident list and create a follow-up ticket to add an integration test for plan-mapper retries + billing webhook ordering. also update runbook to include `force-overwrite` rescue step.

jamie_support: filing follow-up with reproduction steps and timeline. will link ticket here when created.

ryan_eng: created ENG-3125 with patch to upsert path and test. scheduled canary for next deploy.

jamie_support: thanks team — customer unblocked and happy. closing thread after ticket link posted. :thumbsup:

jamie_support: follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3125
